02 / A CLOSER LOOK

WE SHOW. THEN WE WRENCH.

Good repairs start with a clear picture. Take a closer look at the details we check before we recommend a fix.

Example inspection: brake system

01 PADS02 ROTOR03 CALIPER

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

SMALL PART. BIG RESPONSIBILITY.

Brake pads wear with every stop. We check the remaining material and look for uneven wear before recommending replacement.

You see the wear. You understand the recommendation.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

A SMOOTHER WAY TO STOP.

Rotors give the pads a surface to grip. We inspect for scoring, measure thickness, and check for the source of vibration.

A careful measurement. A clear explanation of what comes next.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

PRESSURE. IN THE RIGHT PLACE.

Calipers press the pads against the rotor. We look for leaks, sticking slides, and uneven movement that can affect braking.

Find the cause of the wear. Then agree on the right repair.
